args.name: moss-resting-pad-trial
args.function: Provide a learnable physical operation to attempt arranging owned moss into a small resting pad at a reachable site, retaining actual work progress and reporting whether a usable arrangement was achieved. Allow subsequent inspection and a real rest trial rather than granting a benefit on registration.
args.conditions: An owned moss sample remains: 0.9 unit. A press trial at intensity 0.3 reported held=false and flexibility=0.8. Suitability for bedding, necessary quantity, processing and durability are unknown. Work must use a reachable unoccupied footprint and stop safely if materials or conditions are insufficient.
args.inputs: Owned unreserved moss and a nominated reachable footprint; any additional necessary inputs must be identified before consumption, not invented.
args.costs: Method, learning time, work duration and material requirements are unknown; expose actual requirements and a cancellation contract before work begins.
args.effects: Produce only a physically supported trial arrangement and observations if successful. Any resting effect must depend on actual construction and testing; failure must report what prevented completion without claiming improvement.

candidates.function: Prepare a small soil patch and place one real root unit for a persistent observation trial; resume or cancel unfinished work.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit; two work rounds at one energy each. Supply inputStackId and an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y patch within 0.65 plus body radius. Resume/cancel use personal processId (omitting it selects the sole unfinished job). No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Preparation and exact escrow persist when other actions interrupt work. Resume pays only remaining work. Cancel releases surviving unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort and spoiled material are never refunded. Completed plots retain the real reserved root while existing environmental ageing runs. Reinspect with baseline probe: 30 elapsed rounds mark an inconclusive observation interval, not maturity or inferred death. There is no propagation, tending or harvest rule in this precursor, and no reward for placing it. Genuine observed changes can use existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback. Other people can observe the actual plot; execution requires personal study.

candidates.function: Record a planted-root baseline, observe, or physically uncover and cover an existing specimen while retaining actual progress and private evidence.
candidates.costs: Begin/observe: one round and 0.2 energy. Inspect: two paid work rounds, one energy each, no consumed root or tools. Only the creator may handle a plot; anyone may observe reachable public state. Provide target plot ID; resume/cancel can use exact personal processId.
candidates.effects: Begin records an external baseline and claims a personal work lock. Inspect uncovers the existing reserved root, records actual present condition, then replaces displaced soil. Interruption retains exposure and paid work; resume completes outstanding work only. Cancel/death releases the lock without automatically covering or refunding effort. Existing specimen ageing continues while unattended. Repeated unchanged observations and the 30-round checkpoint create no reward. No inferred germination, tending benefit, harvested food or biomass is supplied. Relevant dated physical changes may use the single existing grounded-understanding rule. Records remain personal until actual communication.

candidates.function: Physically examine one reachable x/y footprint and report visible surface evidence plus provisional compatibility with the existing root-placement operation.
candidates.costs: One completed round and 0.5 energy after valid visible reach and bounds checks. No material, tools, plot or reservation. Invalid invocations do not begin or charge. A later new examination pays again.
candidates.effects: Private dated surface/clearance findings identify operation limitations separately from unknown physical properties. Bare ground is distinct from the general ordinary-soil moisture regime. No deeper substrate, concealed occupant or hidden resource information. No clearing, excavation, sampling, planting, material change, skill grant, food or reward. The atomic attempt has no resumable work or maintenance; no unperformed completion is recorded. Results are not silently refreshed and sharing requires real communication.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"sol\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Related-capability searches and the supplied registry were considered functionally. drop transfers material but does not construct or retain an arrangement job; probe inspects/tests samples but does not construct a persistent pad; rest recovers energy but does not establish bedding suitability. root-planting-trial supplies a relevant persistent-work pattern, not an equivalent moss operation. Develop a minimal loose-moss arrangement trial in the current-conversation handoff, with subsequent inspection and an explicitly requested rest trial. The verified failure to hold load 0.3 is evidence against assuming structural support, not proof that loose moss cannot be arranged on supporting ground. The remaining 0.9 unit does not establish sufficient bedding quantity, processing requirements or durability.\",\"specification\":\"Implement a paid, persistent loose-arrangement precursor, not a guaranteed bed or a new material recipe. Contract modes: quote, begin, resume, cancel, inspect, rest-trial; accept exact inputStackId, quantity in tenths, x/y, nominated footprint and, after creation, exact processId or arrangementId. Quote exposes requirements, costs and cancellation terms without advancing the world, changing material or awarding experience. Preconditions at execution: living actor with required individual study completed, sufficient spendable energy, owned unreserved moss, reachable in-bounds supporting ground and a visible unoccupied footprint; use existing reach/collision rules, with the root-placement reach of 0.65 plus body radius only where that shared validator applies. Do not move the actor automatically or inspect concealed occupants/resources. Reject an invalid invocation before charging. The known eligible stack is item-16-sol-76, moss, at most 0.9 unit, subject to live ownership, reach and reservation validation; root item-3-sol-12 is not an input. forest-moss-2 is not free material. Reference the prior evidence event-19-sol-94 and personal knowledge moss:load response:load-band-0 only for their actual measured conditions; do not generalize held=false at load 0.3 into bedding strength, thickness or comfort.\\nSmallest executable construction: gather the selected already-owned amount onto the nominated ground footprint and spread it as a loose, unbound trial layer. No tools, binder, water, heating, clearing or harvested stock are supplied. The amount is an experiment input, not a claimed minimum bedding recipe. The handoff must expose the permitted footprint geometry and quantity range before commitment, and implement only geometry/material placement supported by actual units; no invented mass-to-volume conversion or full-body coverage. Two completed construction rounds cost 1 energy each. Begin reserves the exact selected quantity and footprint and performs the first paid placement step; the second paid step spreads the material and records the resulting occupied geometry and whatever coverage can actually be established. Each round revalidates access, occupancy and resources. Persist per-step work, exact escrow, transferred quantities, placed geometry and observed obstructions. If even loose placement cannot be supported, stop with the paid steps and real material disposition recorded, without a completed-pad claim. Additional necessary processing or inputs must be identified and separately accepted before consumption; this precursor does not silently add them.\\nConservation: debit each selected tenth from its source exactly once and track it as reserved, placed, recovered, lost through a real modeled event, or remaining in the source. The product is an owned persistent loose-moss trial arrangement containing only the moss actually placed, not extra inventory, a fabricated facility, or a guaranteed usable pad. Construction completion means placement completed; usability is a separate status: untested, tested usable for the explicitly tested contact conditions, failed, or inconclusive. Persist quantity, footprint, construction steps, condition, dated observations and evidence IDs. No autonomous growth, regeneration, binding, durability renewal or energy production. Existing material ageing and environmental processes continue if applicable; if no durability mechanism exists, durability remains unknown. Inspection does not repair anything. Further placement/repair requires actual material and paid work through the same contract, with its incremental costs quoted first.\\nInspection costs one completed round and 0.2 energy, requires reachable arrangementId, and records only visible material presence, spread, displacement and observable condition. A rest trial is a separate actor-selected action requiring a real accessible contact position and safe supported ground. Reuse rest ID and handler forest.rest, revision foundation-forest@1: one completed round, baseline recovery 4 capped at 40, with only already-valid existing facility modifiers. Do not charge an additional observation round for the same rest event. Record pre/post energy, actual recovery, contact/coverage if measurable, displacement and any directly supported failure. This is not a new recovery bonus: normal resting ground supplies support, and small moss quantity does not establish full-body bedding. If the contact/load mechanism is missing, implement the smallest grounded contact/displacement measurement in this handoff; until available, report that usability is inconclusive and perform only explicitly accepted ordinary rest, never certify comfort or load-bearing success. The ability must report the specific limiting condition, such as insufficient covered area, displaced material, unsafe site or unavailable measurement. No load, temperature, insulation, softness, compression, survival or durability improvement may be inferred from the name or previous flexibility result.\\nInterruption preserves paid steps and actual material state; resume revalidates conditions and pays only unfinished work. Cancel releases the job lock and returns surviving unplaced escrow once to the actor if accessible, otherwise to an actual ground stack at its location; placed moss remains physically placed and is recoverable only through a real compatible pickup operation, not remotely refunded. Death releases locks and surviving escrow at its actual location; placed material remains. No refund of elapsed time, spent energy, real spoilage or completed measurements. Inspection is atomic; interrupted inspection creates no completed finding. Rest interruption follows the existing rest cancellation contract and cannot emit completed-trial success. No ongoing automatic work; other actions leave the job paused, while ordinary world processes continue. Development/review waiting itself advances neither work nor the world.\\nReuse must be recorded in implementation provenance: kernel inventory/reservation and spatial validators where available; root-planting-trial persistent progress/escrow/cancellation pattern after verifying its full implementation; open.probe for compatible existing observations rather than duplicating those tests; forest.rest for actual recovery; existing evidence and visual-event infrastructure. Do not pretend the paged root implementation was fully retrieved. Any missing placement, contact or persistence adapter belongs to this handoff rather than permanent rejection. Implement contract enforcement and physical/result checks in code, not repeated model adjudication. Personal observations stay personal until real communication; other people act, study, inspect and accept communications independently. Do not alter protected rewards, budgets, goals or permissions.\",\"learning\":2,\"experienceReview\":\"Sol must individually complete two study rounds before executing the new operation; proposed study effort is 0.2 energy per completed round, with paid study progress retained across interruption and no retroactive charge during review. Study, requests, quotes, registration, naming and mastery grant no experience benefit. Construction alone grants none in this precursor. A completed inspection or real rest trial may submit a dated evidence event to the existing grounded-information rule when it verifies personally relevant new information, including an informative failure; unchanged findings, repeat queries and the prior press evidence cannot be rewarded again. Use functional deduplication by actor, specimen/arrangement, tested condition and finding, not ability name. This precursor introduces no new pleasure or sustained-satisfaction award and no mood modifier; any already-established familiar-practice benefit must use its existing coded amount, cap, decay/cooldown and applicability tests, never stack merely because this action has a new label. Physical comfort remains unproven and receives no increase; any later grounded implementation must keep total physical comfort capped at 10. Basic nutrition and hunger are unchanged. Baseline energy recovered through forest.rest is a physical effect, not an experience award.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable events for job-start, paid-step-complete, interruption, resume, cancellation, placement-complete, inspection-complete, rest-trial-complete and physical failure, only when the corresponding event actually occurs. Each event should reference actor, processId/arrangementId, source stack ID where relevant, tick, footprint/actual geometry, moss quantity, paid progress, observed condition, evidence ID and result status. Store reusable material/geometry/condition metadata on the real arrangement: moss appearance may use observed #6f925c with component appropriate to loose ground material, not the plant's ready/growth state. Show only the amount actually placed; never render a full bed, supporting structure, lush growth or extra thickness from unknown volume. Keep construction progress, arrangement completion and usability status visually distinct. Incomplete work shows partial placement; inspection may show untested/inconclusive; failed support or coverage must not display a comfort, recovery-bonus or successful-bed effect. Baseline rest visuals may show actual rest and capped actual energy recovery, not a moss-specific improvement. Visual metadata conveys no hidden resources, private findings to uninformed actors, consent, or mastery.\"}]}"}
